proposals.evidence: Full vardala gives regional badal/badar, and its addendum explicitly gives Jaunsari badli clouds and Kotgarhi badal. Dotyali baldo cloud is a qualified metathesized regional match, preserving the transposed l/d sequence and final vowel. Precise local development and cross-IA transmission remain qualified. Exact response: bāldo.
